description: Inspect a specific URL's index status in Google: coverage state, last crawl, canonical, mobile usability, and rich-results status. Use to debug why a page is or isn't indexed.

inspectionUrl.description: The fully-qualified URL to inspect (must belong to siteUrl), e.g. "https://example.com/page"

siteUrl.description: The property the URL belongs to, exactly as listed by gsc_list_sites

name: gsc_inspect_url
title: Gsc Inspect Url
